name: Dragon Adventures
notes: Dragon Adventures 0.9.2: ?debug=keys shows a last-12 input log (type, key, code, repeat, target, document.hasFocus, handler decision, plus toast/FX show calls). It is inert without the flag and offline-safe (Workbox ignores the debug query). Q matches e.key when code is empty and still fires if the first event is a ghost-repeat after keyup. F uses the same nearby-dragon target as the ride prompt, so a friend beside you (even mostly off-screen) gets the friend toast. The Tap to keep playing title lives in the JS bundle as well as HTML, and the overlay also appears when pointer lock is lost mid-play. Schema v5, IDB/cacheId/test-* denylist unchanged. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
